name: KYC Document Review Agentic Subprocess
description: CALM architecture specification for the bounded-autonomy KYC document review workflow (Chapters 10, 12, and 14).

nodes.name: KYC Document Store
nodes.description: Stores customer-uploaded onboarding documents (passports, proof-of-address, corporate registry extracts) prior to review.

nodes.name: KYC Document Review Agent
nodes.description: Bounded-autonomy agent that extracts fields from onboarding documents, invokes sanctions screening, and submits structured recommendations to the deterministic gate.

nodes.name: Sanctions & PEP Screening Service
nodes.description: External or internal screening service queried against OFAC, UN, EU, and PEP watchlists.

nodes.name: Deterministic Risk & Confidence Gate
nodes.description: Deterministic decision gate (implemented via Fluxnova BPMN/DMN reference engine) that evaluates sanctions match status, extraction confidence, and risk tier outside the model.

nodes.name: KYC Case Management Queue
nodes.description: Downstream case queue receiving auto-cleared low-risk cases or escalated analyst tasks. The agent has queue-write authority only and cannot close a compliance file.

nodes.name: KYC Compliance Analyst Review
nodes.description: Mandatory human-in-the-loop review step for any confirmed/possible sanctions hit, low-confidence extraction, or medium/high risk tier.

nodes.name: Fluxnova Orchestration Engine
nodes.description: Reference deterministic BPMN orchestration engine hosting the KYC workflow and enforcing process boundaries.

nodes.name: Fluxnova DMN Decision Engine
nodes.description: Reference deterministic DMN evaluation service executing the KYC Risk & Confidence decision table.

nodes.name: Enterprise LLM Inference Provider
nodes.description: External/shared model inference endpoint invoked by the KYC agent under zero-data-retention and token-budget controls.

relationships.description: KYC Agent reads uploaded documents from the KYC Document Store (read-only).
KYC Agent queries the Sanctions & PEP Screening Service for watchlist matches.
KYC Agent submits structured extraction output, confidence score, and sanctions status to the deterministic gate.
Deterministic gate routes verified low-risk, high-confidence, zero-sanctions cases to the Case Management Queue.
Deterministic gate routes any confirmed/possible sanctions hit, <95% confidence, or elevated risk case to a human analyst.
KYC Agent invokes the Enterprise LLM Inference Provider for document field extraction.

no-sanctions-override.description: The KYC agent cannot auto-clear any case with a confirmed or possible sanctions/PEP match; all such cases must route to human-analyst-task.

mandatory-human-review.description: Any case with extraction confidence below 0.95 or risk tier above low must escalate to human-analyst-task via the deterministic gate.

untrusted-document-boundary.description: Uploaded customer documents are sanitized and isolated inside a strict data-only delimiter boundary before model invocation.

ccc-workload-isolation.description: KYC workflow and external model calls run within an isolated cloud workload boundary with zero provider training retention and bounded token/cost quotas.
